OGC CQL2 1.0 JSON examples

Repository: https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogcapi-features
Tag: cql2-1.0.0
Commit: 5788bf0dabd8fb4ffdeb4aefea547d308843aeb1
Directory: cql2/standard/schema/examples/json
Source: https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogcapi-features/tree/cql2-1.0.0/cql2/standard/schema/examples/json

All 109 JSON files are unmodified copies from that directory. Their original
filenames and contents are preserved; each file was checked against its upstream
Git blob SHA during import. The upstream LICENSE is included alongside them.
Tests do not access the network.

Each fixture has an independent construction test in tests/test_ogc_examples.py.
These use the public model constructors, including nested predicates, enums,
geometries, temporal literals and functions. They compare both model_dump and
model_dump_json with the fixture, then validate the fixture back into its model.
Comparison ignores object-key order and insignificant JSON whitespace. JSON
numbers compare by value (4 and 4.0 are equivalent); booleans are kept distinct
from numbers. Optional unset geometry fields are omitted with exclude_none=True.

When updating the corpus, use an explicit upstream revision, retain every JSON
example, update the construction tests and this provenance record, and review
upstream licensing changes.
